}}'''Mori''' is an [[Aiel]] ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]''.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Mori}}

== Activities ==
She is one of the Aiel who accompany [[Perrin Aybara]] into [[Ghealdan]]. While traveling from [[Malden]], she scouts an area of land that appears to have been affected by the [[Blight]].

== Trivia ==
* Mori is named for Susan Moore, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
